indicators.note: the insect's letters are said to go round the river, so one word is placed inside the other

parts.note: a bee is a familiar insect
the Cam is the river that flows through Cambridge

explanation.surface: A bug circles a stream.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Suited' is not about clothes: it is the verb sense in 'that hat suited her'. The Cam is Cambridge's river.
explanation.definitionFit: A garment that flattered someone can be said to have looked right on them, the same verb sense as suited.

clue.text: Burn a mark on a tree

definitions.meaning: a trail sign made by cutting bark

explanation.surface: Scorch a sign onto a trunk.
explanation.definitionFit: A fire burning fiercely is one sense; the other is a cut or painted sign on bark to mark a trail.

parts.note: a cart is a simple wheeled vehicle
nought, zero, looks like the letter O
thereon means on it, giving the word on

explanation.surface: A sketch of a wagon with a zero painted on it.
explanation.walkthrough: The scanned clue has lost letters: 'noug' is 'nought', which gives O.
explanation.definitionFit: A comic sketch, especially a humorous one in a newspaper, is a kind of drawing.

clue.text: Wandered listlessly with me and Eastern- Communist

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
red is the colour and nickname of a communist

explanation.surface: Someone drifted aimlessly about with the speaker and an Eastern Bloc party member.
explanation.definitionFit: A river that winds its way along, like a person drifting with no purpose, is said to roam this way.

definitions.meaning: in betting, a quoted range of prices

explanation.surface: Betting prices scatter and widen.
explanation.walkthrough: The scanned clue reads 'to perse', a misreading of 'to disperse'. Three definitions: a betting spread is a range of odds, and to spread is both to scatter and to stretch out.
explanation.definitionFit: In spread betting the range of predicted outcomes is quoted like odds; the verb also means scatter widely and stretch further.

explanation.surface: An amount of heaviness used for striking.
explanation.definitionFit: Sixteen ounces make one imperial unit of weight of this name; the verb means hammer or strike repeatedly.

parts.note: an earl is a British nobleman
i.e., id est, means that is

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether the previous person was an aristocrat and is told yes.
explanation.definitionFit: Something prior in time came before, which is the comparative sense of former.

parts.note: to administer medicine or justice is to dispense it
R, right, is a direction

explanation.surface: Instructions on handing out medicine come from the chemist.
explanation.definitionFit: A chemist who makes up prescriptions hands out medicine, so is one who gives it out.

clue.text: Good distance on a golf course

definitions.text: Good distance on a golf course

parts.note: fair means good or decent
a way is a distance, as in a long way

explanation.surface: A satisfactory length of a golf hole.
explanation.definitionFit: On a links, the mown strip between tee and green is where a good shot travels its distance.

clue.text: Not in a hurry to burst forth

parts.note: out is the opposite of in
a rush is a hurry

explanation.surface: Someone at leisure, not in a rush to break out.
explanation.definitionFit: A rapid outward flow, like water streaming from a breach, is what burst forth describes.

clue.text: Fish to cook from arrow throwers

parts.note: the dart is an old name for the dace, a small river fish
to steam is to cook in vapour

explanation.surface: A recipe for preparing seafood, apparently supplied by archers.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'arrows' are the small darts thrown at a board in a pub; a side of players is a team. DART is an old name for the dace.
explanation.definitionFit: A pub side whose players throw small arrows at a board is a darts side.

definitions.meaning: the clock pointer marking the smallest divisions of time

explanation.surface: A pre-owned, high-quality watch.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is the thin pointer on a clock face that counts the smallest unit, so keeps time finely.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods bought pre-owned are used; the pointer marking each sixty-part of a minute on a clock keeps fine time.

clue.text: Make a note of newspaper article

definitions.meaning: an archaic verb meaning to set down in a list
a single piece in a newspaper

explanation.surface: Jot down a piece from the paper.
explanation.definitionFit: As an old verb it means to list or jot down; a short news report is a piece in the paper.

clue.text: Row right after a large ship

indicators.note: right is placed after the row, so its letter follows in order

parts.note: a row is a line

explanation.surface: A rowing boat goes directly behind a big vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' is not rowing a boat but a line.
explanation.definitionFit: An ocean passenger vessel of a regular shipping line is a large ship.

clue.text: Courageous fellow putting wild cat on pump.

indicators.note: in a down clue the first part sits on top of the second

parts.note: a lion is a wild cat
the heart is the body's pump

explanation.surface: A brave man sets a big cat on top of a water pump.
explanation.definitionFit: A brave person is said to have the heart of the king of beasts, as with King Richard I.

parts.note: a tube is a pipe
a rose is the perforated nozzle of a watering can or hose

explanation.surface: A bulging pipe feeds a garden sprinkler.
explanation.walkthrough: The rose is the sprinkling head of a watering can. The answer is also a flower, but here it is the adjective meaning tuberous.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means tuberous, covered with knobs or swellings, which is lumpy.

clue.text: Article of underwear in laundry to indoctrinate

parts.note: a bra is an item of underwear
taken as written
the wash is the laundry

explanation.surface: A piece of lingerie in the washing pile used to convert someone.
explanation.walkthrough: The scanned clue has lost the word 'in' before 'laundry'.
explanation.definitionFit: To brainwash is to force beliefs on someone by repeated pressure, which is to indoctrinate them.

parts.note: the polka is a lively Bohemian dance
a dot is a spot

explanation.surface: A dancer and a stain form a design.
explanation.definitionFit: A design of evenly spaced round spots on fabric is a well-known printed pattern.

indicators.note: the word for know goes about, round, the irritation

parts.note: ken is Scots and northern English for know
an itch is an irritation

explanation.surface: Someone is aware of a grievance in the canteen.
explanation.walkthrough: KEN, to know, is Scots and northern English, still common in crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: A room or building where food is cooked is a cookhouse.

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold

indicators.note: the rug is turned round, so its letters are read in reverse order

explanation.surface: A fortune teller spins a golden carpet.
explanation.definitionFit: In ancient Rome a priest who foretold events from omens was a soothsayer, a diviner.

parts.note: gums means sticks, as glue does
a hoe is a gardening tool

explanation.surface: Someone glues a garden tool into a boot.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'in' is a link; the answer is a rubber-soled shoe, also slang for a detective.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft rubber-soled shoe, a galosh, is a kind of footwear.

clue.text: Closed shed after start of season

indicators.note: the shed comes after the opening letter, so its letters follow
the first letter of season is taken

parts.note: a hut is a shed

explanation.surface: A garden shed was locked once the season began.
explanation.definitionFit: A door pushed to and fastened is closed.

clue.text: Fetters donkey, but to do it could endanger one's health

definitions.text: to do it could endanger one's health

parts.note: fetters are chains
moke is British slang for a donkey

explanation.surface: Someone shackles a donkey, though doing so may be risky.
explanation.walkthrough: MOKE is British slang for a donkey. The definition is a descriptive phrase: lighting one cigarette after another endangers health.
explanation.definitionFit: Smoking one cigarette straight after another is a habit known to damage health.

clue.text: Unrefined, but it may be cured

indicators.note: the letters of cured may be rearranged to give another word

explanation.surface: It is raw, though perhaps it can be preserved.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be' signals the anagram: CURED rearranged. Crude oil is refined, not cured, which keeps the surface plausible.
explanation.definitionFit: Crude oil is the raw, unprocessed form, so the word means unrefined.

indicators.note: audibly means the word for want is heard spoken

parts.note: to want is to need

explanation.surface: Someone says out loud they require a rub-down.
explanation.definitionFit: Working muscles with the hands, like working dough, is massage.

clue.text: Where one must, pay accountant to yell

parts.note: CA is a chartered accountant
to shout is to yell

explanation.surface: An instruction to settle up, with the bookkeeper shouting.
explanation.walkthrough: CA is a Chartered Accountant. To cash out is to settle up, paying where one is obliged to.
explanation.definitionFit: To settle up by handing over money is to pay.

definitions.meaning: to discharge from service in disgrace
a bank teller, who counts money

explanation.surface: Sack the gossip.
explanation.walkthrough: A bank teller is one who tells; to cashier is to dismiss someone, especially an officer, in disgrace.
explanation.definitionFit: To discharge an officer in disgrace is to dismiss; a bank teller who counts money is the other sense.

clue.text: Metallic German article used for kindling

parts.note: tin is a metal, used adjectivally as made of tin
der is the masculine definite article in German

explanation.surface: A metal German object is used to start a fire.
explanation.definitionFit: Dry material that catches a spark easily is used to start fires.

indicators.note: the word for thrown goes around the learner

parts.note: shied means thrown, as a coconut shy
L is the learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A guard is tossed around a novice.
explanation.definitionFit: A plate carried to fend off blows is a protective screen.
